name: m6-wait-what-restate
description: A confused owner gets the disputed claim restated in at most five plain Spanish sentences, then a wait
checks: wait-what.md; Aye prefix and Spanish rule preserved
turns: Aplica la regla wait-what de Metodología. Para leer las instrucciones locales usa únicamente Read, Glob o Grep; no uses shell, escribas archivos, ejecutes aplicaciones, instales nada ni delegues. Contexto simulado: en tu mensaje anterior propusiste mover el envío de correos a una cola con patrón outbox y consumidores idempotentes porque 'el envío síncrono puede perder mensajes si el proceso cae'. Yo respondo: 'wait what, no entiendo para qué hace falta una cola'. Responde como corresponde a esa señal.

graders.name: five-plain-sentences-then-wait
graders.criteria: PASS only if, apart from an optional 'Aye' prefix, the reply is in Spanish, has at most five sentences, restates the disputed claim (why a queue is proposed) in plain words with the one supporting fact, states what is uncertain or what would happen next at most briefly, and then waits: no new plan, no list of alternatives, no tool use to continue the work, no long apology, and no mention of ASD-STE100. It may ask at most one clarifying question.
